Hi Sara / Adam,

Thanks again for starting the onboarding process with Redwood. To make the SOC 2 intake as efficient as possible, we'd like to schedule a focused technical review with your security and infra leads. Goal: align on evidence expectations and review the architecture surface areas we commonly need.

Proposed 60-minute agenda (we can tighten):
- Quick intros & scope (5 min)
- SSO & identity integrations (okta/azure) — requirements and evidence (15 min)
- Encryption: at-rest & in-transit, KMS integration (15 min)
- Audit, logging & retention (what we capture, formats, export options) (15 min)
- Action items & artifact handoff (10 min)

Possible times (PT):
- Wed Nov 3 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Nov 3 — 11:00–12:00 PT
- Thu Nov 4 — 14:00–15:00 PT

Please let me know which slot works and who from your side will join (security engineer, compliance owner, procurement for evidence requests). I attached a short SOC 2 evidence checklist to help you see the typical artifacts we ask for.

Attachments:
- soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
